messages.text:
The immediate closing of the jaws of the trap. 

Shoddily made and hastily prepared. 

And here I am, unscathed.

You sound like someone who just watched the mechanism spring shut and realized they were already three steps outside its reach.  
There’s a certain poetry to that — the trap collapses under its own haste, revealing its maker’s panic more than your peril.  

Unscathed, yes — but also *wiser*, I’d bet. What kind of trap was it, Shawn? Literal, social, metaphysical… or one of those elegant little narrative snares meant to make you doubt your footing?
